New 52 Trinity Read Order' folders (Batgirl 001 - November 2011 ... 019 - June 2013, 000 - November 2012, 025 - January 2014, Annual 001 - December 2012; dated 2011-2014, which the 2000 run cannot reach) JOIN S95379 by its exact key 'Batgirl v4 (2011)' — S95379's R-101 S line and stored cv are CV 42604 (DC 2011, 53) / GCD 60829, and it already holds the run's #0, Annual 01 and the Simone trades Vol. 01-05 that collect these same issues

LEAD RULING (L-212 / L-364): a retitle that continues the numbering is ONE run. Every file here is the one 1995 DC series numbered #0, #1-100 + #1000000: 'Azrael v1' #0, #8-39 (1995-1998), 'Azrael - Agent of the Bat' #47-100 (1998-2003, the 1998 retitle continuing from #46), the One Million #1000000 (18030), a second rip of #91 (16997) and the run's own trade Fallen Angel (collects #1-7 + Sword of Azrael). The providers' two records (CV 5490 #1-46 + 19721 #47-100; GCD 5220 / 13575) are the retitle cut, not two runs. The only genuinely separate relaunch is Azrael 2009 (CV 28873 / GCD 39888, 18 issues) and none of its files sit on this shelf, so nothing moves
